title: Debiasing isn’t enough! – On the Effectiveness of Debiasing MLMs and their Social Biases in Downstream Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated extrinsically by measuring True Positive Rate (TPR) gaps between genders in occupation classification (BiasBios), calculating differences in semantic similarity scores for gendered sentence pairs (STS-bias), and computing the Fraction Neutral (FN) metric on gender-swapped premise-hypothesis triples in Natural Language Inference (NLI-bias).

bias_targets.target: General social biases (including race, religion, and profession)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated intrinsically by comparing the pseudo-log-likelihood (PLL) scores and attention weights (AULA) that Masked Language Models (MLMs) assign to stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentence pairs using the StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs datasets.
